verdict.rationale: Headless or CI-driven automation is a fair question for a SaaS accounting product, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documented headless, CLI, or CI usage. The developer portal said to host a GraphQL API returned 403, so no API docs could be verified, and the marketing pages document no API, CLI, or webhook surface. Built-in features like recurring invoices and automated reminders are in-app scheduling, not headless operation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
